-- 肌肉技能V1
CommonFunc:GetInstanceTagAddedSignal(GameEnum.Tag.MuscleV1,function(player:Player, connections)
    print(string.format("MuscleV1 已应用到 %s",player.DisplayName))

    local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(1,Enum.EasingStyle.Elastic,Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
    local onCharacterAdded = function(character:Model)
        if not character then return end
        local humanoidRootPart:Part = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        ValueHelper:InitByModel(character,MuscleValue)
        local v_muscle:NumberValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(character,MuscleValue.muscle)
        local v_strength:NumberValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(character,MuscleValue.strength)
        local v_hunger:NumberValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(player,PlayerValue.hunger)

        local armL:BasePart = character:FindFirstChild("Left Arm")
        local armR:BasePart = character:FindFirstChild("Right Arm")

        local originArmSizeL = armL.Size
        local originArmSizeR = armR.Size
        local lastStrength = v_strength.Value
        local onStrengthChanged = function()
            if v_strength.Value > lastStrength then
                AudioHelper:PlayEffect("大只佬升级1",character)
                EffectHelper:PlayWorkspaceEffect("LeveUp",nil,humanoidRootPart,3)
            end
            lastStrength = v_strength.Value
            local armSizeOffset = Vector3.zero
            if v_strength.Value == 3 then
                armSizeOffset = Vector3.new(0.7,0,0.7)
                ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(character,CharacterValue.MaxHealthBonus,"肌肉加成",1)
                ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(character,CharacterValue.attackBonus,"肌肉加成",1)
                -- AudioHelper:PlayEffect("大只佬升级",character)
            elseif v_strength.Value == 2 then
                armSizeOffset = Vector3.new(0.1,0,0.1)
                ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(character,CharacterValue.MaxHealthBonus,"肌肉加成",0)
                ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(character,CharacterValue.attackBonus,"肌肉加成",0)
            else
                armSizeOffset = Vector3.new(-0.5,0,-0.5)
                ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(character,CharacterValue.MaxHealthBonus,"肌肉加成",-0.25)
                ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(character,CharacterValue.attackBonus,"肌肉加成",-0.25)
            end

            TweenService:Create(armL,tweenInfo,{Size = originArmSizeL + armSizeOffset}):Play()
            TweenService:Create(armR,tweenInfo,{Size = originArmSizeR + armSizeOffset}):Play()
            -- armL.Size = originArmSizeL + armSizeOffset
            -- armR.Size = originArmSizeR + armSizeOffset
        end
        onStrengthChanged()
        v_strength.Changed:Connect(onStrengthChanged)
        v_muscle.Changed:Connect(function()
            local newStrength = 1
            if v_muscle.Value > 75 then
                newStrength = 3
            elseif v_muscle.Value > 25 then
                newStrength = 2
            end
            v_strength.Value = newStrength
        end)

        task.spawn(function()
            while GameHelper:CharacterIsAlive(character) do
                local dt = 1
                local handTool = ToolHelper:GetToolsInHand(player)
                if not handTool or not handTool:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Dumbbell) then
                    local cost = 1
                    if v_hunger.Value > 200 then
                        cost = 0.1
                    elseif v_hunger.Value > 100 then
                        cost = 0.5
                    end

                    GameHelper:AddMuscle(player,-cost)
                end
                task.wait(dt)
            end
        end)
    end
    onCharacterAdded(player.Character)
    table.insert(connections,player.CharacterAdded:Connect(onCharacterAdded))
end)
-- 肌肉技能V2
CommonFunc:GetInstanceTagAddedSignal(GameEnum.Tag.MuscleV2,function(player:Player, connections)
    print(string.format("MuscleV2 已应用到 %s",player.DisplayName))
    table.insert(connections,validatedHit.Event:Connect(function(triggerPlayer,target,tool,profile,damage,targetKind)
        if not newMeleeSwitch.Value then return end
        if triggerPlayer ~= player then return end
        if not tool then return end

        local character = player.Character
        local v_strength:NumberValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(character,MuscleValue.strength)
        if v_strength.Value < 3 then return end

        if targetKind == "Tree" then
            if not tool:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Axe) then return end
            local isKill = math.random(1,10) == 1
            if isKill then
                GameHelper:TreeTakeDamge(player,target,9999)
                AudioHelper:PlayEffect("秒杀",character)
            end
        elseif targetKind == "NPC" and GameHelper:IsNPC(target) then
            if not tool:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.MeleeWeapon) then return end
            local isKill = math.random(1,20) == 1
            if isKill then
                GameHelper:NPCTakeDamage(player,target,9999)
                AudioHelper:PlayEffect("秒杀",character)
            end
        end
    end))

    table.insert(connections,GameHelper.CharacterHitTargetC2S.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(triggerPlayer,target:Model)
        if newMeleeSwitch.Value then return end
        if triggerPlayer ~= player then return end
        local tool = ToolHelper:GetToolsInHand(player)
        if not tool then return end

        local character = player.Character
        local v_strength:NumberValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(character,MuscleValue.strength)
        if v_strength.Value < 3 then return end

        if target:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Tree) or target:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.BigTree) then
            if not tool:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Axe) then return end
            task.wait()
            if math.random(1,10) == 1 then
                GameHelper:TreeTakeDamge(player,target,9999)
                AudioHelper:PlayEffect("秒杀",character)
            end
        elseif GameHelper:IsNPC(target) then
            if not tool:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.MeleeWeapon) then return end
            if math.random(1,20) == 1 then
                GameHelper:NPCTakeDamage(player,target,9999)
                AudioHelper:PlayEffect("秒杀",character)
            end
        end
    end))
end)

-- 吸血鬼V1
CommonFunc:GetInstanceTagAddedSignal(GameEnum.Tag.VampireV1,function(player:Player, connections)
    print(string.format("VampireV1 已应用到 %s",player.DisplayName))
    local v_isDaytime:NumberValue = ValueHelper:WaitValue(GameHelper:GetController(),TimeValue.isDaytime)
    local v_suckBloodBonus:NumberValue = ValueHelper:WaitValue(player,PlayerAttributeValue.suckBloodBonus)
    local v_suckBloodProb:NumberValue = ValueHelper:WaitValue(player,PlayerAttributeValue.suckBloodProb)

    local onDayTimeChanged = function()
        if not GameHelper:isAlive(player) then return end
        local character = player.Character
        ValueHelper:WaitValue(character,CharacterValue.WalkSpeedBonus) -- 这是为了异步时，等待初始化完成
        if v_isDaytime.Value then
            ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(character,CharacterValue.MaxHealthBonus,"吸血鬼加成",-0.3)
            ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(character,CharacterValue.WalkSpeedBonus,"吸血鬼加成",0)
            ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(character,CharacterValue.attackBonus,"吸血鬼加成",0)
        else
            ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(character,CharacterValue.MaxHealthBonus,"吸血鬼加成",0)
            ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(character,CharacterValue.WalkSpeedBonus,"吸血鬼加成",1.8)
            ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(character,CharacterValue.attackBonus,"吸血鬼加成",0.1)
        end
    end

    local onCharacterAdded = function()
        local character = player.Character
        if not character then return end
        ValueHelper:WaitValue(character,CharacterValue.WalkSpeedBonus) -- 这是为了异步时，等待初始化完成
        onDayTimeChanged()
    end
    onCharacterAdded()
    -- 吸血鬼有1倍的饥饿恢复加成，但只能吃肉
    ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(player,PlayerAttributeValue.HungerRecoveryBonus,"吸血鬼加成",1)
    player:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.OnlyEatRawMeat)

    -- 吸血鬼吸血加成
    ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(player,PlayerAttributeValue.suckBloodBonus,"吸血鬼加成",20)
    -- 吸血鬼吸血概率加成
    ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(player,PlayerAttributeValue.suckBloodProb,"吸血鬼加成V1",0.1)

    table.insert(connections,player.CharacterAdded:Connect(onCharacterAdded))
    table.insert(connections,v_isDaytime.Changed:Connect(onDayTimeChanged))
    table.insert(connections,validatedHit.Event:Connect(function(triggerPlayer,target,tool,profile,damage,targetKind)
        if not newMeleeSwitch.Value then return end
        if triggerPlayer ~= player then return end
        if not tool or not tool:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.MeleeWeapon) then return end
        if targetKind ~= "NPC" or not GameHelper:IsNPC(target) then return end

        -- 随机是否吸血
        local isSuckBlood = math.random() <= v_suckBloodProb.Value
        if isSuckBlood then
            -- 吸血
            GameHelper:PlayerForceHeal(player,v_suckBloodBonus.Value)
            EffectHelper.PlayVisualEffectS2C:FireAllClients("吸血",triggerPlayer.Character,target)
        end
    end))

    table.insert(connections,GameHelper.CharacterHitTargetC2S.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(triggerPlayer,target:Model)
        if newMeleeSwitch.Value then return end
        if triggerPlayer ~= player then return end
        local tool = ToolHelper:GetToolsInHand(player)
        if not tool or not tool:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.MeleeWeapon) then return end
        if not GameHelper:IsNPC(target) then return end

        if math.random() <= v_suckBloodProb.Value then
            GameHelper:PlayerForceHeal(player,v_suckBloodBonus.Value)
            EffectHelper.PlayVisualEffectS2C:FireAllClients("吸血",triggerPlayer.Character,target)
        end
    end))
end)

-- 雷神V1
CommonFunc:GetInstanceTagAddedSignal(GameEnum.Tag.ThorV1,function(player:Player, connections)
    print(string.format("ThorV1 已应用到 %s",player.DisplayName))
    -- player:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.ThorV2)
    -- player:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.ThorV3)

    ValueHelper:InitByModel(player,ThorValue)
    local v_energy:NumberValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(player,ThorValue.energy)

    local config = game.ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Jobs"):FindFirstChild("雷神")
    local energyUp = config:FindFirstChild("攻击命中充能").Value
    local energyMax = config:FindFirstChild("最大能量").Value
    local radius = config:FindFirstChild("雷神之怒半径").Value
    local skillDamageUp = 0 -- 技能伤害

    if player:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.ThorV2) then
        radius = config:FindFirstChild("2级雷神之怒半径").Value -- 2级雷神技能增加雷神之怒半径
    end
    if player:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.ThorV3) then
        energyUp = config:FindFirstChild("3级攻击命中充能").Value -- 3级雷神技能增加雷神之怒充能更快
        skillDamageUp = config:FindFirstChild("3级雷神之怒伤害增加").Value -- 3级雷神技能增加雷神之怒伤害
    end

    if not player:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Reconnection) then
        -- 装备雷神锤
        local tool = ResourcesItemHelper:CreateItem(113)
        ToolHelper:Pinkup(player,tool)

        -- 装备雷神护甲
        local armor = ResourcesItemHelper:CreateItem(311)
        AccessoryHelper:Equip(player,armor)
    end

    table.insert(connections,GameHelper.onPlayerMeleeWeaponHitTarget.Event:Connect(function(p:Player,npc:Model,damage:number)
        if p ~= player then return end

        if v_energy.Value >= energyMax then
            -- 触发技能
            v_energy.Value = 0 -- 清空能量

            local overlapParams = OverlapParams.new()
            overlapParams:AddToFilter(npc)
            overlapParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
            local hits = workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(npc:GetPivot().Position,radius,overlapParams)

            local hitNpcs:{Model} = {npc}
            for _,hit:BasePart in ipairs(hits) do
                local isNpc,hitNpc = GameHelper:IsNPC(hit)
                if not isNpc then continue end

                if not table.find(hitNpcs,hitNpc) then
                    table.insert(hitNpcs,hitNpc)
                end
            end

            AudioHelper:PlayEffect("雷神之怒",player.Character)
            local lastHitNpc:Model = nil
            for index,hitNpc in ipairs(hitNpcs) do
                task.wait(0.1)
                if not hitNpc:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then continue end

                -- 伤害
                GameHelper:NPCTakeDamage(player,hitNpc,damage + skillDamageUp)

                -- 使用雷神技能击杀统计
                if not GameHelper:CharacterIsAlive(hitNpc) then
                    GameHelper:MarkCharacterStats(player,GameEnum.CharacterStatsId.ThorSkillKill,1)
                end

                EffectHelper.PlayVisualEffectS2C:FireAllClients("雷神技能",lastHitNpc,hitNpc)
                lastHitNpc = hitNpc
            end
        else
            v_energy.Value += energyUp
        end
    end))
end)

-- 一无所有之人：数据驱动的永久高难角色
local _nobodyConfig = _Jobs:WaitForChild("一无所有之人")
local _nobodyStates = {}
local _nobodyStartItemsGranted = {}
local NOBODY_BONUS_NAME = "一无所有之人"
local NOBODY_TAGS = {
    GameEnum.Tag.NobodyV1,
    GameEnum.Tag.NobodyV2,
    GameEnum.Tag.NobodyV3,
}

local function hasNobodyTag(player:Player)
    for _,tag in ipairs(NOBODY_TAGS) do
        if player:HasTag(tag) then
            return true
        end
    end
    return false
end

local function getNobodyLevel(player:Player)
    if player:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.NobodyV3) then
        return 3
    elseif player:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.NobodyV2) then
        return 2
    end
    return 1
end

local function getNobodyMultiplier(player:Player)
    local levels = _nobodyConfig:WaitForChild("等级倍率")
    local value = levels:FindFirstChild(string.format("%d级",getNobodyLevel(player)))
    return value and value.Value or 1
end

local function getNobodyValue(group:Instance,name:string,defaultValue:number)
    local value = group:FindFirstChild(name)
    return value and value.Value or defaultValue
end

local function setNobodyPlayerBonuses(player:Player,multiplier:number)
    local penalties = _nobodyConfig:WaitForChild("负面状态")
    ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(player,PlayerAttributeValue.hungerCostBonus,NOBODY_BONUS_NAME,getNobodyValue(penalties,"饥饿消耗倍率修正",0) * multiplier)
    ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(player,PlayerAttributeValue.HungerRecoveryBonus,NOBODY_BONUS_NAME,getNobodyValue(penalties,"食物恢复倍率修正",0) * multiplier)
    ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(player,PlayerAttributeValue.fogEnd,NOBODY_BONUS_NAME,getNobodyValue(penalties,"视野距离修正",0) * multiplier)
    ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(player,PlayerAttributeValue.JumpPowerBonus,NOBODY_BONUS_NAME,getNobodyValue(penalties,"跳跃力修正",0) * multiplier)
    ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(player,PlayerAttributeValue.openTreasureSpeedBonus,NOBODY_BONUS_NAME,getNobodyValue(penalties,"开箱速度倍率修正",0) * multiplier)
    ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(player,PlayerAttributeValue.BagSizeBonus,NOBODY_BONUS_NAME,math.round(getNobodyValue(penalties,"背包容量修正",0) * multiplier))
end

local function setNobodyCharacterBonuses(player:Player,character:Model,multiplier:number)
    if not character or player.Character ~= character then return end

    ValueHelper:WaitValue(character,CharacterValue.WalkSpeedBonus)
    local base = _nobodyConfig:WaitForChild("基础设置")
    local removeHat = base:FindFirstChild("移除帽子")
    if multiplier ~= 0 and removeHat and removeHat.Value then
        CharacterHelper:ClearHat(character,true)
    end

    local penalties = _nobodyConfig:WaitForChild("负面状态")
    ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(character,CharacterValue.MaxHealthBonus,NOBODY_BONUS_NAME,getNobodyValue(penalties,"最大生命倍率修正",0) * multiplier)
    ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(character,CharacterValue.WalkSpeedBonus,NOBODY_BONUS_NAME,getNobodyValue(penalties,"移动速度修正",0) * multiplier)
    ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(character,CharacterValue.damageReduction,NOBODY_BONUS_NAME,getNobodyValue(penalties,"伤害减免倍率修正",0) * multiplier)
    ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(character,CharacterValue.attackBonus,NOBODY_BONUS_NAME,getNobodyValue(penalties,"通用伤害倍率修正",0) * multiplier)
    ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(character,CharacterValue.meleeAttackBonus,NOBODY_BONUS_NAME,getNobodyValue(penalties,"近战伤害倍率修正",0) * multiplier)
    ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(character,CharacterValue.healItemBonus,NOBODY_BONUS_NAME,getNobodyValue(penalties,"治疗效果倍率修正",0) * multiplier)
    ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(character,CharacterValue.healItemSpeedBonus,NOBODY_BONUS_NAME,getNobodyValue(penalties,"治疗速度倍率修正",0) * multiplier)
end

local function clearNobody(player:Player)
    local state = _nobodyStates[player]
    if state and state.characterConnection then
        state.characterConnection:Disconnect()
    end
    _nobodyStates[player] = nil

    setNobodyPlayerBonuses(player,0)
    if player.Character then
        setNobodyCharacterBonuses(player,player.Character,0)
    end
end

local function applyNobodyCampfire()
    local base = _nobodyConfig:WaitForChild("基础设置")
    local configuredLevel = getNobodyValue(base,"初始营火等级",1)
    configuredLevel = math.clamp(math.round(configuredLevel),1,#CampfireSetting.data)

    local startLevel:IntValue = workspace.GameValue:FindFirstChild("初始营火等级")
    if startLevel then
        -- 共享效果只取最大值；多个 Nobody 不叠加，也不会缩小已开放地图。
        startLevel.Value = math.max(startLevel.Value,configuredLevel)
    end
end

local function grantNobodyStartItems(player:Player)
    if _nobodyStartItemsGranted[player] then return end
    _nobodyStartItemsGranted[player] = true
    if player:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Reconnection) then return end

    local base = _nobodyConfig:WaitForChild("基础设置")
    local idsValue:StringValue = base:FindFirstChild("初始道具Ids")
    local ids = idsValue and idsValue.Value or ""
    if ids == "" then return end

    for _,idText in ipairs(string.split(ids,",")) do
        local cleanIdText = string.gsub(idText,"%s+","")
        local itemId = tonumber(cleanIdText)
        if not itemId or not ResourcesItemHelper:GetLo(itemId) then
            warn(string.format("Nobody 初始道具Id无效: %s",idText))
            continue
        end

        local item = ResourcesItemHelper:CreateItem(itemId)
        if item then
            ToolHelper:Pinkup(player,item)
        end
    end
end

local function refreshNobody(player:Player)
    if not player or not player:IsDescendantOf(Players) then return end

    local base = _nobodyConfig:WaitForChild("基础设置")
    local enabled:BoolValue = base:FindFirstChild("启用")
    if enabled and not enabled.Value then
        clearNobody(player)
        return
    end

    local state = _nobodyStates[player]
